title: Inconsistent behavior of DEBUG, debug_toolbar_urls()
author: candletrick

title: Sidebar avatar renders as a square block instead of a circle after AdminLTE 4 upgrade (3.0.5)
author: jskitz
body_preview: ## Summary  Since the AdminLTE 4 upgrade, the sidebar user avatar renders as a large square block instead of a small rounded circle.
